hook: Millions of posters print the popular 'be the change' slogan.

sections.voiceover: Millions of posters print the popular 'be the change' slogan.
Mahatma Gandhi died in 1948, which predates the slogan entirely. Educator Arleen Lorrance wrote it in a 1974 book chapter in Brooklyn, New York. Where did the famous attribution start?
Quote Investigator researchers found the misattribution except thousands of digitized pages prove Gandhi left zero trace.
Literary Hub author Benoit Denizet-Lewis met Arleen Lorrance to uncover the truth.
The 1948 death date proves Gandhi missed the book entirely.
